meta.name: sparse-autoencoder-training
meta.description: Provides guidance for training and analyzing Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) using SAELens to decompose neural network activations into interpretable features. Use when discovering interpretable features, analyzing superposition, or studying monosemantic representations in language models.

copy.tagline: 训练稀疏自编码器分解神经网络激活为可解释特征
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在研究语言模型内部表征或叠加现象
copy.tagline_en: Train sparse autoencoders to decompose neural activations into interpretable features
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are studying internal representations or superposition in language models

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 SAELens 库训练和分析稀疏自编码器（SAE），将神经网络激活分解为可解释的特征，用于理解模型内部概念。
howto.when: 当你需要发现模型中的可解释特征、分析叠加现象或研究单义表示时触发。

say.text: 帮我加载 GPT-2 Small 的预训练 SAE 并分析特征。
say.note: Claude 会给出加载和分析步骤。

say.text: 如何训练一个自定义 SAE 来分解模型第8层的激活？
say.note: Claude 会提供训练配置和代码。

say.text: 用特征 1234 对输出进行干预。
say.note: Claude 会展示特征引导的生成方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in using the SAELens library to train and analyze Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), decomposing neural network activations into interpretable features for understanding model concepts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to discover interpretable features in model activations, analyze superposition, or study monosemantic representations.

say_en.text: Help me load a pretrained SAE for GPT-2 Small and analyze features.
say_en.note: Claude will provide loading and analysis steps.

say_en.text: How do I train a custom SAE to decompose layer 8 activations?
say_en.note: Claude will provide training config and code.
